t.name: Saheeh International
a: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Those who make show [of their deeds]

t.name: Julio Cortés
a: ¿Qué te parece el que desmiente el Juicio?
Es el mismo que rechaza violentamente al huérfano
Y no anima a dar de comer al pobre.
